authorization.text: Dann lasse forge die Mocks ebenfalls erarbeiten. Danach vergleichen wir die 4 proben

findings.required: loop must keep scheduling RAF but freeze time; reset last timestamp while hidden so resume causes no jump.

findings.defect: After seek to 36, pressing next event sets t to 0.4.
findings.required: step at/after final event must stay at D; replay remains the play-button behavior.

findings.defect: When its containing section has hidden or document.hidden is true, simulated time advances to 36 before the card is viewed.
findings.required: frame must keep scheduling RAF but freeze time; reset last timestamp while hidden so resume causes no jump.
